findings.title: Refund rule contradicts the cancellation policy stated in task-001
findings.why: task-001 says the policy is: cancelling under 24 h before start gives no refund, otherwise a full refund. `cancel` gives a full refund at any time before the start, so a cancellation 1 hour before start is fully refunded. task-005 wrongly says 'the request does not state one', and the tests (e.g. cancel at 2026-05-31T12:30 for a 06-01 00:00 start) encode the wrong rule.

findings.title: Task claims no refund policy exists, but task-001 defines one
findings.why: The 'assumption to confirm' replaces the documented 24 h rule with a different one without mentioning the conflict.

findings.title: Plan documents are unfilled scaffolds
findings.why: Plans 1-2 to 1-5 contain only the placeholder comment, which itself says to replace it. The `element` and `parent` fields are empty and the plan bodies are missing.

findings.title: Overflow check on `full * 9` also applies to hourly rentals
findings.why: Hourly totals are never multiplied by 9, but a large hourly total with `full * 9` above the safe-integer limit throws 'total is too large' anyway. The check belongs only in the daily-discount branch.
